mapper.update: update sys_user set password = #{newPassword} where password = #{oldPassword} and user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, mobile = #{mobile}, email = #{email}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, role_ids = #{roleIds}, dept_id = #{deptId} where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set user_status = 2 where user_id = #{userId} and is_super_admin = 0
mapper.select: select distinct p.permission_code from sys_user u join sys_role r on json_contains(u.role_ids, cast(r.role_id as json)) join sys_permission p on json_contains(r.permission_ids, cast(p.permission_id as json)) where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_status=1;
select user_id from sys_user where username = #{username} and password = #{password} and user_status = 1 limit 1
select username from sys_user where user_id = #{id}
select real_name as realName, gender, mobile, email, hire_date as hireDate, role_ids as roleIds, dept_id as deptId from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
select real_name as username, gender, mobile from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
